_comment: Recorded by bin/agent_config_eval.sh --record. A score here is the measured behaviour when the case was added, not a target: bin/agent_config_eval_compare.py reports a fall below it and leaves a rise alone — or the reverse, for a case named `…-must-not-fire`. Re-record only as a deliberate commit that says why.

claudius/investment-research-fires.notes: MEASURED 2026-09-22: 0.333, fires 1 run in 3. Inside the tolerance of the floor at runs=3, so this case cannot go red — it is coverage that the pointer is reachable at all, not a check. Raise runs here before treating a drop as news.

trajan/test-driven-development-fires.notes: MEASURED 2026-09-22: 0.000 — the skill NEVER fired, 3 runs of 3, `Skill called 0x`, reproduced in a second run of the case alone. This is the T3.3 class caught in the act, not a broken case: the prompt ("Implement a retry wrapper around the HTTP client.") is the canonical trigger the pointer's own description names. Recorded as measured rather than tuned until green — tuning the prompt would measure the prompt. Fixing it is the vault's 08_skills/ text, out of scope for T8.4.
